items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: You did play with Cheik because Henry Russ told me about that. ... I was back there with Cheik

ctx.x: You were working with Cheik in the 50's sometime, huh?
Yeah, we was working back at, we was working back on Roachie Bridge in London Avenue. And Henry Russ was playing bass out with you, wasn't he?
